tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Notwithstanding any other provision of Federal or State law, the Institute is authorized to develop a policy or policies for the Institute to extend preference to Indians in—

children.text: admissions to, and enrollment in, programs conducted by the Institute,
contracts, fellowships, and grants awarded by the Institute.

tree.heading: Hiring preference
tree.text: In carrying out section 4416(b)(1) of this title, the President of the Institute shall, to the maximum extent practicable, give preference in hiring to Indians.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1992—Subsec. (a). Pub. L. 102–325 inserted “develop a policy or policies for the Institute to” after “is authorized to”.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1992 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 102–325 effective Oct. 1, 1992, see section 2 of Pub. L. 102–325, set out as a note under section 1001 of this title.
